messages.message: Enable login via Google+. Requires completion of the fields below. The PHP CURL extension must also be enabled on the server.

You receive this when you register your website as an app on Google+. Click "API Access", then "Create an OAuth 2.0 client ID". Under "Redirect URIs", enter the full URL in the following form: http://www.myDomain.com/websoccerfolder/?page=home&action=googleplus-login.
You also receive this when registering your website on Google+.
